invariants.rationale: The method expects config to be a valid HoodieWriteConfig; a null config would most likely be invalid.
The method switches on config.getIndexType(), so it must be safely callable and non-null to avoid NullPointerException.
If the index type is SIMPLE, getKeyGeneratorForSimpleIndex(config) must be non-null since it is used to construct the index.
Similarly, for GLOBAL_SIMPLE index type, getKeyGeneratorForSimpleIndex(config) must provide a non-null value.
If getIndexClass() is not null or empty, the method calls createUserDefinedIndex, which should return a non-null index.
